name: Ensnared Bloom
source:
Responding to a strange call, Anna Ashfield, a local police officer, is sent alone to investigate the location in the midst of a storm. As she approaches the large mansion, nothing seems out of ordinary at first, but she'll soon find out that she's in for a lot more than she signed up for... 

[From [url=https://noodledonut.itch.io/ensnared-bloom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
接到一通蹊跷的报警电话后，当地女警官安娜·阿什菲尔德冒着狂风暴雨，孤身一人被派往现场展开调查。当她走近那栋庞大的宅邸时，起初一切看似并无异样；但她很快就会发现，等待着自己的凶险远超想象……

[摘自[url=https://noodledonut.itch.io/ensnared-bloom]itch.io[/url]]
